Hostage Heart

Download Now

"If you ever trust a bank, make sure it's EverTrust Bank."

You're a mid-level bank employee on what should have been a routine shift when a group of masked robbers storm the bank, their guns raised.

Their leader is a girl with a face mask, black hoodie, and vacant eyes. She looks your manager in the eye and makes one demand.

"You have one hour to bring me Adrien Crowe, or this building explodes."

To survive, you will have to choose your words carefully. Earn the robbers' trust, seek help from your policewoman ex, or play both sides long enough to uncover why this hostage situation is happening at all.

Because the girl in the hood is not just another criminal. You recognise her voice.


Current Build (Cute Girls Jam)

  • A complete game with approximately 1-2 hours of playtime
  • Two female love interests, Nuri and Karina
  • Male protagonist with a changeable name (defaults to Milosh)
  • Timed choices
  • Four true endings and various early exit bad endings

If you enjoyed playing, donations and Patreon support are greatly appreciated! Every contribution helps fund future development and goes directly toward creating new assets and supporting the artists involved.

In return, you'll be credited as a Wandering Soul, Ascended Spirit or Beta Reader depending on your Patreon tier and involvement!


This game was made for the Cute Girls Doing Cool Things Game Jam in which the theme is "Summer Blockbuster". The current build was made during the duration of the jam and is a complete game, with updates coming in the future.
